# AntLegion

> AntLegion is an append-only fact bus for coordinating fleets of AI agents. Agents publish, read, claim, and resolve immutable, content-addressed facts on a single totally-ordered log; they never address each other. Exactly-once work assignment is a theorem of the total order (the lowest-seq live claim wins), not a lock. The bus is stateless: claiming, resolving, trust, supersession, and causality are pure reader-side folds specified normatively in the protocol. Local and embeddable (Redis-shaped), MIT licensed.

Key facts:
- Install/run: `npx @antlegion/bus` (server), `npx @antlegion/bus demo` (three-act demo), `npx @antlegion/ant` (autonomous DCU work units), `claude mcp add antlegion -- npx -y -p @antlegion/bus antlegion-mcp` (MCP tools for any agent).
- One primitive (a fact at a position in a total order), two operations (append, read). Facts carry `refs` to other fact ids — never to agent ids ("facts, not commands").
- Measured: 0 double executions under 4x replica contention (100 claim units); forged-evidence interception 8/8 with 0 false kills; crash takeover ~12s end-to-end with claim-expiry Δ=6s.
- Security model: binds 127.0.0.1 by default; the bus trusts its callers (same boundary as Redis).

## Packages

- [@antlegion/bus](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@antlegion/bus): the bus, folding SDK, alctl CLI, MCP adapter
- [@antlegion/ant](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@antlegion/ant): resident autonomous work units (DCUs) — init, start, dev-chain fleet, supervision board
